label: illustrative mapping, not a compliance attestation

PG001.title: No public S3 buckets
PG001.remediation: Use a private ACL and set all four public access block settings to true.

PG002.title: Encryption at rest
PG002.remediation: Add a server-side encryption configuration for the bucket, or set encrypted or storage_encrypted to true.

PG003.title: No wildcard IAM actions or resources
PG003.remediation: List the specific actions and resource ARNs the role needs instead of * or service:*.

PG004.title: Actions pinned by commit SHA
PG004.remediation: Replace the tag or branch with the full 40 character commit SHA and keep the version in a comment.

PG005.title: Least-privilege workflow permissions
PG005.remediation: Add a permissions block with contents: read and grant extra scopes only to the job that needs them.

PG006.title: OIDC instead of static cloud keys
PG006.remediation: Grant id-token: write and assume a cloud role through OIDC with role-to-assume instead of stored keys.
